notes.note: Re-recorded after merging origin/main into the reload-approval follow-up branch. The record was taken from main, where it was reviewed with main's steerTurn clientInputId, steerTurnOnce and inspectSteerInput additions. The sources that differ from it (docs/reference/session-api.md) carry this branch's one paragraph in docs/reference/session-api.md: a snapshot carries ids only, and after a reload the client reads the newest turn to rebuild each open approval's tool, preview and grant label, keeping a placeholder otherwise. I read the merged file: the two changes are in different sections (snapshot open requests vs the steer commands), merged without conflict, and neither contradicts the other.
